acceptance: `evolve phases check-provenance --cycle N` on a fixture with a mismatched artifact prints the violation and exits 1 (red: unknown subcommand)
An unreadable ledger, or a ledger line over the scanner's limit, exits 2
fix: Add `evolve phases check-provenance --cycle N [--json]`, which runs CheckProvenance over each of cycle N's phase artifacts and prints the violations. Exit 0 when clean, 1 on any violation, 2 when the ledger cannot be read or scanned completely, so it never passes silently. Document it in runtime-reference.md beside check-coherence.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: phasecoherence.CheckProvenance compares a phase artifact's provenance fields with the ledger (internal/phasecoherence/provenance.go:28); only its test calls it. `evolve phases check-coherence` and `check-artifact-coherence` (phases.go:39-41) cover other checks. CheckProvenance also ignores ledger open errors and stops silently past a 64 KiB line (inbox phasecoherence-provenance-silent), so a command built on it must report those cases as failures.
title: The ledger provenance check of a cycle's phase artifacts is unreachable; add `evolve phases check-provenance --cycle N`
